description:
Migrate the email services for the domain 'acmecorp.test' to Microsoft Office 365 by updating its DNS records in Virtualmin. 

Starting from the default local configuration:
1. Remove any existing local MX records.
2. Add a new MX record pointing to 'acmecorp-test.mail.protection.outlook.com' with Priority 0.
3. Update the existing SPF (TXT) record to 'v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all' (do not create a duplicate SPF record).
4. Add a CNAME record for 'autodiscover' pointing to 'autodiscover.outlook.com'.
5. Add an SRV record for SIP Federation: Name='_sip', Protocol='_tls', Priority='100', Weight='1', Port='443', Target='sipdir.online.lync.com'.

Navigate to 'Server Configuration' > 'DNS Records' for the domain to make these changes.
